findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window
findings.rationale: Specifies the account lock trigger but omits the lockout duration, unlock/recovery mechanism, and user error response.

findings.evidence: notify him by email
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' has multiple plausible antecedents in the sentence (Librarian, Member, or Guarantor).

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the token expiration duration.

findings.evidence: user-friendly; easy to navigate; loads rapidly; standard connections
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms with no measurable usability or performance thresholds.

findings.evidence: at most TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder for the maximum number of consecutive loan renewals.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Describes only the happy-path outcome of eligibility validation without specifying system behavior when an item is ineligible or a barcode scan fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References a numeric limit on active hold requests without specifying the actual maximum count.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Specifies a simultaneous borrowing limit of 8 physical items, conflicting with the limit of 5 physical items in SD-009.

findings.evidence: standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days
findings.rationale: Sets the standard print book loan period to 21 calendar days, conflicting with the 14 calendar days duration in SD-010.

findings.evidence: Unverified visitors shall be able to self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Permits online self-registration and checkout with only an email address and no ID verification, contradicting SD-001's rule that a Librarian must verify government-issued photo ID and record full name, email, and phone number.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: Requires reserved items on the pickup shelf to be held indefinitely until cancelled by the Member, conflicting with SD-011's 72-hour hold expiration and automatic cancellation.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Uses stacked 'and/or' connectives, leaving it ambiguous which combination of actions must be executed at 7 days overdue.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded with a reason code in the audit log
findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without identifying which role or system component reviews, approves, and records fine waiver requests.

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: Includes the subjective, non-binding qualifier 'if appropriate' without defining objective criteria for when SMS alerts are sent.

findings.evidence: for TBD years
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the receipt retention period.

findings.evidence: overdue fine of $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap
findings.rationale: Specifies an overdue fine of $1.25 USD/day with no cap, conflicting with SD-019's rate of $0.50 USD/day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: permitted to renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Allows item renewal regardless of unpaid fine balance, conflicting with SD-020's rule blocking renewals when unpaid fines exceed $5.00 USD.

findings.evidence: Patron's; Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Introduces the term 'Patron' instead of the established domain term 'Member' used in earlier requirements such as SD-001 and SD-009.

findings.evidence: quickly; many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ('quickly', 'many users') with no measurable latency SLA or concurrency threshold.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: Uses the non-binding loophole phrase 'where possible', making term highlighting optional and untestable.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy; acceptable response times
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms ('sufficient', 'acceptable') without defining quantitative accuracy or response-time criteria.

findings.evidence: efficiently; large batch MARC21 files; without noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: Uses vague, unquantified terms ('efficiently', 'large', 'noticeable system slowdown') without measurable throughput, file size, or impact limits.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: Specifies detecting active loans or holds on deletion attempt without specifying the resulting system action (such as blocking deletion or returning an error).

findings.evidence: at TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the database backup schedule interval.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions; in a timely manner; an appropriate period
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ('important', 'in a timely manner', 'an appropriate period') without defining which actions, latency bounds, or retention duration apply.

findings.evidence: If the primary database node becomes unreachable for more than 10 seconds, the Failover Manager shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: Specifies logging FAILOVER-01 when the primary database becomes unreachable but omits the failover, recovery, or alerting action to take.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security; clear error messages
findings.rationale: Uses subjective qualifiers ('adequate', 'clear') without specifying concrete security protocols or error message criteria.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any password of at least 8 characters, conflicting with SD-002's minimum length of 12 characters and uppercase/lowercase/numeric character requirements.

findings.evidence: keep authenticated web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Sets the inactivity session timeout to 60 minutes, conflicting with the 15-minute inactivity timeout in SD-004.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Requires reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt passwords, directly contradicting SD-003's requirement to hash passwords with bcrypt and never store plaintext.
